kite.description: Kite MCP server: lets Claude Code draw and edit real, editable design layers (frames, text, components, auto layout) in a Kite (kite.new) file your team edits live, then copy any frame as HTML, React or Tailwind. Remote server hosted by kite.new. Requires a Kite account (free plan: 3 files, 200 agent actions a day). Uses OAuth authentication; nothing runs locally.
